fix_commit_message:
Bug 1945318 - Don't try to reparent an empty stack r=jandem

Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D236587
agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix ea3513a38b03 on top of intro 2c17d3b90e38 via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (OutOfBoundsRead): When Error.captureStackTrace is called with a startAt function that hasn't been seen yet on the stack, the stackChain vector remains empty. However, the code for reparenting async stacks unconditionally accesses stackChain[stackChain.length() - 1], which causes an out-of-bounds access when stackChain is empty. The condition for entering the reparenting block checks multiple criteria (activation change, async stack presence, etc.) but fails to verify that stackChain actually contains frames to reparent. Root cause: The introduction of the Error.captureStackTrace feature added a 'startAt' parameter that delays adding frames to the stackChain vector until a specific function is seen. The existing code for async stack reparenting was not updated to account for this new behavior, and unconditionally accesses stackChain[stackChain.length() - 1] without checking if frames have been added yet.
